details:
VRChat Version: SDK 2022.06.03.00.04
Description of the bug: Modified blendshapes of the avatar are tripled if there is an animation touching the same blendshapes present, but not played, on the FX Layer and "Write Defaults" on both Left and Right hands is enabled in the Gesture Layer. Playing said animation will correctly set blendshape values as expected.
Steps to reproduce (how did you encounter the bug?):
Create a project. Import SDK (and Lyuma Avatar Emulator to see effect in-editor). Import an avatar. Check that "Write Defaults" on the Left and Right Hands in the Gesture Layer is set to ON. Not using a Gesture Layer at all or an empty one resulted in the same issue. Change a blendshape on the body that is not permanently being controlled by anything else to a non-zero value. The effect possibly appears on zero values too, but there it cannot be noticed. Make an animation that alters the same blendshape. Put this animation in the FX Layer and such, that it is not being played right away. In play mode, you will find this blendshape to be set to triple the value you originally set.
Fix: Since there are reasons to utilize "Write Defaults ON", one possible solution is to make an empty animation, create a new layer on the Gesture Layer, add this empty animation to be played automatically all the time and have this set to "Write Defaults OFF". I had inconsistent results and it seemed to be most reliable if this layer is the very last one.
An example where this might show up is having the floof on a Rexouium reduced by some amount via blendshapes but making an animation to toggle on a shirt that reduces this floof even more to prevent clipping. With the shirt on, values are set correctly by the animation. With the animation off, the originally set values are 3x.
title: Altered blendshape values tripled by inactive fx layer animation
